# 佛說師子奮迅菩薩所問經

**ID:** T1357

**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 317–420
**Juans:** 1

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle anonymous translation, the colophon "失譯人名今附東晉錄" — "translator's name lost, now appended to the Eastern-Jìn catalog". Conventional dating bracket: Eastern Jìn 東晉 (317–420). The Taishō editors mark the parallel "[Nos. 1356, 1358, 1359]" — i.e. paired with [KR6j0586](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0586) (Wú, [支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) Zhīqiān), [KR6j0588](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0588) (anonymous-Eastern-Jìn), and [KR6j0589](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0589) (Northern Sòng, [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Shīhù); all four render the same Indic source.

**Abstract**

The frame is identical to [KR6j0586](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0586): the Buddha at Lake Anavatapta in the *nāga*-king's palace, 500 *bhikṣus*, 1,000 bodhisattvas of one-life-remaining. The interlocutor is named *Shīzǐ Fènxùn* 師子奮迅 (Siṃha-vikrīḍita / Siṃha-vikrama, "Lion-Sprung"). His question is the same — how great is the merit of offering to the Tathāgata? — and the Buddha's reply, with its *huājù* (花聚, "Flower-Heap") dhāraṇī, is once again prescribed for memory-retention with the same monthly *uposatha*-ritual as in [KR6j0586](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0586). The transcription of the dhāraṇī is recognisably more archaic than the Wú-period [KR6j0586](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0586), with simpler phonetic conventions and shorter rendering of Indic clusters — features consistent with an early-Eastern-Jìn translation.

The text demonstrates the multi-recensional life of the *Puṣpa-rāśi-dhāraṇī* in pre-Suí China; the parallel-translation cluster preserves both the Wú-period Zhīqiān rendering and (here) an anonymous Eastern-Jìn version, plus [KR6j0588](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0588) (a closely related but distinct text under the title 花聚) and [KR6j0589](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0589) (the Sòng re-translation). Nanjio N0382.
